summary: After a ruling in {state}, a union asks a national employer to bargain over terms for plants there.
realLife: The UAW wrote to GM after an Indiana appellate ruling allowed an agency-shop arrangement under the state law then in force. GM declined a meeting, and the union filed a charge.
gates: The case record identifies the dated state ruling, affected plants and bargaining request.
inGame: needs: dated state ruling, affected plants and bargaining request.

turns.what: The proposal can be negotiated without any promise of adoption.
The union can put the refusal before the board.
turns.pulledBy: The employer declines on legal grounds
